cases.title: Quality gaps identified in a deficient test case
cases.objective: Verify analyze_gaps reports each weak model feature with a status and a concrete recommendation.
cases.expected: Vague When-only test with no linked requirement -> 7 gaps: Preconditions, Expected Result, Specificity, Clarity, Requirement Coverage, Completeness, Requirement Link (Test Steps present, so not flagged).

cases.title: Improved Given/When/Then scenarios generated
cases.objective: Verify the improved test is valid Gherkin with a happy-path and an invalid-input scenario, each with Given/When/Then, and folds in the linked ACs.
cases.expected: 2 scenarios; each has Given, When, Then; an 'And the result satisfies the linked acceptance criteria' step containing the AC text.
cases.actual: HTTP 200; scenarios=2; each has G/W/T: [True, True]; AC folded in: True

evidence.label: Improved Gherkin
evidence.value:
Feature: Login

  Scenario: Improved — User Login succeeds
    Given a registered user is authenticated and on the "User Login" page
    When the user performs the required action for "User Login" with valid input values
    Then the system completes "User Login" successfully and returns a confirmation
    And the result satisfies the linked acceptance criteria: The user can login with a valid email and password If the password is wrong, the system displays an invalid email or password error

  Scenario: Improved — User Login handles invalid input
    Given a registered user is authenticated and on the "User Login" page
    When the user performs the required action for "User Login" with invalid or missing input values
    Then the system rejects the action and displays a specific validation error message

cases.title: Quality score recalculated through the same pipeline
cases.objective: Verify the 'after' score is measured by re-running feature extraction and the model on the rewritten text, not asserted.
cases.expected: improved_quality_score == compute_quality_score(improved_features); improved_features == extract_features(improved_description); score rises from Low to High.
cases.actual: Before 19.82 (Low) -> after 94.05 (High/High); features re-extracted identically: True
